title: Continuity for bounded-below etale complexes
statement:
Let $X=\varprojlim_jX_j$ be a small cofiltered system of quasi-compact
quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine
transition maps. For a finite commutative ring $\Lambda$, let $K_i\in\Dplus(X_{i,\Et},
\Lambda)$ and let $K_j,K$ be its inverse images
[def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image]. Then the canonical restriction map is an
isomorphism

$$
 \varinjlim_{j\geq i}H^nR\Gamma(X_{j,\Et},K_j)
 \xrightarrow{\sim}H^nR\Gamma(X_{\Et},K)
 \qquad(n\in\mathbb Z).
$$
Here $\Dplus(X_{i,\Et},\Lambda)$ is the derived category of sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and $R\Gamma$ is computed by applying sections at the terminal object to a K-injective resolution [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions], [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. The notation $j\geq i$ means the category of stages equipped with a transition to $i$ (the overcategory of $i$), rather than an assumed ordering of the index category. Restriction sends a section of a resolution to its inverse image, followed by a comparison to a resolution on the target site.

proof.text: Restrict D along Over.forget i₀, an initial functor since I is cofiltered (Mathlib CategoryTheory.Filtered.Final). Functor.Initial.isLimitWhiskerEquiv transports hc to the restricted cone. Compactness, quasi-separatedness and affine transition maps are inherited directly from D. The arrows D.map i.hom form a natural transformation from the restricted diagram to the constant diagram at D.obj i₀; its naturality follows from Over.w and D.map_comp.

Apply the exact functor taking a module sheaf to its underlying abelian sheaf to K. The constructed coefficient comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-derived-module-underlying-comparison] identify every stage cohomology group and the cone point after forgetting Λ. Apply their naturality to each transition and each projection, then cancel the comparison isomorphisms to verify exactly hm and hs for the abelian diagram F followed by forget₂.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-derived-etale-cohomology-limit] to this restricted diagram, its limit cone, the structure maps D.map i.hom, the underlying bounded-below complex, and the transported object isomorphisms and map equations. This gives IsColimit of forget₂.mapCocone s. Mathlib isColimitOfReflects for ModuleCat to AddCommGrpCat gives IsColimit s.
